settings.subtitle: Design Philosophy
settings.title: Where Architectural Restraint Meets Tactile Luxury.
settings.quote: We do not build ordinary accessories. We craft timeless spatial artifacts designed to elevate the human touch.
settings.body_text: Founded in Milan with engineering studios in Tokyo, Vision SH operates on the conviction that digital tools should exist in total aesthetic harmony with refined physical environments.

settings.title: Architectural Geometry & Restraint
settings.description: We eliminate every superfluous ornament. Every angle is dictated by the ergonomic natural resting position of the human hand and spatial computing hardware.

settings.title: Aerospace Grade 5 Titanium
settings.description: Selected for its supreme strength-to-weight ratio and hypoallergenic properties. Precision-milled to 0.02mm microscopic tolerances.

settings.title: Multi-Stage Hand Buffing & Satin Anodization
settings.description: Each surface undergoes four stages of microscopic hand finishing, creating a soft matte sheen that diffuses ambient room light with subtle grace.

settings.title: Tactile Equilibrium for Modern Workspaces
settings.description: Engineered with integrated neodymium magnetic coupling and acoustic damping silicone pads for zero friction and permanent stability.

settings.heading: Uncompromising Micro-Tolerances.
settings.description: Machined from a monolithic billet of Grade 5 titanium, every bevel and surface is hand-finished to microscopic precision.

settings.heading:
Pure Materiality.
Zero Compromise.
settings.subheading: Every piece is manufactured under ISO-certified microscopic tolerances, creating timeless artifacts that endure across decades of daily use.

settings.subtitle: Finishing Process
settings.title: The Art of Micro-Finishing
settings.description: Slide to observe the meticulous transition from raw CNC-milled billet to our multi-stage hand-buffed satin finish.
